description: This file implements health check handlers and utilities for Kubernetes API server, including various health checkers (ping, logging, cache sync, shutdown), and functions to install health endpoints like /healthz, /readyz, and /livez.

classes.name: healthzCheck
classes.description: Implements the HealthChecker interface with a name and check function.

classes.name: groupedHealthzCheck
classes.description: Implements GroupedHealthChecker, embedding a HealthChecker and adding a group name.

classes.name: log
classes.description: Implements a health checker that verifies logging is not blocked, periodically flushing logs.

classes.name: informerSync
classes.description: Implements a health checker that verifies cache synchronization via cacheSyncWaiter.

classes.name: shutdown
classes.description: Implements a health checker that fails if the stop channel is closed, for graceful shutdown detection.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the health checker.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Performs the health check, returning error if unhealthy.

methods.name: GroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for grouped health checkers.

methods.name: NewInformerSyncHealthz
methods.description: Creates a health checker that passes only if all informers are synced.

methods.name: NewShutdownHealthz
methods.description: Creates a health checker that fails if the stop channel is closed.

methods.name: InstallHandler
methods.description: Registers health check handlers on a mux for /healthz.

methods.name: InstallReadyzHandler
methods.description: Registers readiness check handlers on a mux for /readyz.

methods.name: InstallLivezHandler
methods.description: Registers liveness check handlers on a mux for /livez.

methods.name: InstallPathHandler
methods.description: Registers health checks on a specific path.

methods.name: InstallPathHandlerWithHealthyFunc
methods.description: Registers health checks with a callback for first-time healthy event.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the healthzCheck.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Executes the check function for healthzCheck.

methods.name: GroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for groupedHealthzCheck.
